title: Weary Cat Emoji 🙀 Meaning: Shock, Not Tiredness
description: Despite its name, the 🙀 weary cat emoji is a screaming, shocked cat with paws on its cheeks. See what it means, how it is used and how it compares to 😱.
summary: The 🙀 weary cat emoji shows a cat with wide eyes, open mouth, and paws pressed to its cheeks. Despite the name, almost nobody uses it for tiredness. It means shock, horror, or dramatic disbelief, the cat equivalent of 😱, usually in an exaggerated or comic way.
meaning: The official name is misleading. 'Weary' suggests exhaustion, but the picture is a cat mid-scream, and people follow the picture. 🙀 is what you send when the gossip is scandalous, the price is outrageous, or the plot twist came out of nowhere. It is a gasp. The paws on the cheeks copy the pose of 😱, which itself echoes the figure in Edvard Munch's painting The Scream.

Because it is a cat, the fear is never very convincing. That is its strength. A human screaming face can look like real panic; the cat version makes the reaction theatrical, the way you might clutch your chest and say 'how dare you.' It is common for mock outrage, for pretending to be scandalized by a friend's confession, and for cute overreactions to small surprises.

Cat owners use it literally for startled pets, including the famous cucumber-scare style of clip, and for household disasters seen from a cat's point of view, such as an empty food bowl. A smaller group does use it as named, for being overwhelmed or at the end of their rope, but that reading is rare enough that it may confuse the reader.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: Reply with 🙀 to news that makes your jaw drop: an engagement, a breakup, a friend dyeing their hair green. It says 'no way' without words. It is lighter than 😱, so it suits surprises that are juicy or funny more than ones that are truly alarming.

contexts.label: On social media
contexts.body: In comments it reacts to dramatic reveals, transformation videos, and celebrity news. People also use it sarcastically for things that are not shocking at all, like a store raising a price by ten cents. In that mode the oversized reaction is the joke.

contexts.label: On pet accounts
contexts.body: Photos of cats with huge pupils, puffed tails, or mouths open mid-meow get captioned with 🙀. It narrates feline drama around bath time, vet visits, and vacuum cleaners. Here the emoji is close to a portrait of the animal in the picture.

examples.meaning: Mock horror at a high price.
Playful disbelief at a friend's confession.

examples.text: The vacuum came out and Milo levitated 🙀

examples.meaning: Sudden panic on realizing something important.

combos.meaning: Escalating disbelief at a big reveal.
Shock at how much something costs.
Scandalized and eager to hear more of the gossip.
A nod to videos of cats startled by cucumbers.

confusedWith.difference: 😱 is the human original with the same hands-on-cheeks pose and a blue-tinted forehead. It handles stronger fright and more serious shock. 🙀 is the softer, funnier option, best for gossip and mock outrage.
😩 is the emoji that actually means weary: fed up, exhausted, or overwhelmed. 🙀 shares the word in its name only. If you want to say you are drained, use the yellow face.
😿 is sad, with a tear and a downturned mouth. 🙀 is startled, with an open mouth and raised paws. One mourns, the other gasps.

avoid: Do not use it to react to real emergencies or frightening news, where a cartoon scream trivializes the situation.
Avoid relying on it to say you are tired, since most people will read shock instead.
design: A cat's head with ears and whiskers, wide white or blank eyes, a mouth open in a scream, and both front paws held against its cheeks. Many vendors tint the top of the head blue, as they do for 😱, to suggest the blood draining from the face. The fur is otherwise yellow or orange.

faqs.q: Why is it called weary cat if it looks scared?
faqs.a: The name comes from the original Unicode label, Weary Cat Face, assigned in 2010. The artwork, inherited from Japanese carrier sets, shows a shocked expression, and platform designers kept that look. Usage has followed the image, not the name.

faqs.q: What does 🙀 mean from a girl or a guy?
faqs.a: They are shocked or pretending to be. It is a dramatic 'omg' reaction, usually friendly and often amused. There is no flirtatious meaning attached to it.
They express the same reaction in the same pose. The difference is tone. 😱 can be used for real fear, while 🙀 nearly always signals playful or exaggerated shock.
Technically, since that is its name, and a few people use it for being overwhelmed. It is uncommon, though. For exhaustion, 😩 or 😫 will be understood far more reliably.
